class_provenance_warning:
These are recorded here from the fan wikis, but nobody has yet opened the
    VGO Emulator client and confirmed them. They may be exactly right, they may
    carry figures the game never used, or they may not be in the emulator at
    all — there is no way to tell from the sources alone.
    
      Of this class's 166 abilities,
      115 have had their tooltip read in game.
    
    Where a tooltip has been read it overrides the wikis, and around four in
    five disagreed with them — so treat the figures below with care.

Previously recorded by The Telon Project as: “Wanes the body and mind of an opponent, dealing normal damage plus 53 and lowers aggression for your defensive target” (http://thetelonproject.wikidot.com/abilities:waning-palm-i)

Secret of Ice III

Monk · Level 36 · Buff · (Dragon Discipline)

Effect

Speaking the secret of ice grants your attacks a chance to deal an additional 88 to 93 ice damage, slows your target's attack speed by 18% and reduces movement speed. There is also a 9% chance to freeze your opponent for 4 sec. Only one Secret may be active at a time.

As it was earlier

Previously recorded by The Telon Project as: “Speaking the secret of ice grants your attacks a chance to deal an additional 98 to 104 ice damage, slows your target's attack speed by 18% and reduces movement speed. There is also a 9% chance to freeze your opponent for 4 sec” (http://thetelonproject.wikidot.com/abilities:secret-of-ice-iii)

The level recorded here was read from the VGO Emulator client. the vanguardmonks.com ability table, captured in 2008 gives a different one, and it is not an error in either: that page describes the game as it stood in 2007 and the emulator runs a much later build, so the Monk's abilities were rebalanced between the two. Forty of the Monk's abilities differ this way.
